cc:Work.dc:title: figure4_valuation_planning_realization
cc:Work.dc:description: Figure 4. Valuation, planning, and set realization. (a) Retrospective substitutions expose valuation and bounded planning effects. (b) Greedy and beam-width-four selection retain positive regret relative to the retrospective joint set within the registered two-action reachable pool.
